clips.title: The story
paras: Auntie Bernice Stonefield's missing necklace has left Billy Maclure bargaining for a pork belly pie. The Stonefield and Maclure families have feuded for generations, and Billy will say who has the necklace only after he gets his pie.

Billy Maclure gives no apology when asked about Auntie Bernice Stonefield's missing necklace. He will not return it or say who has it until he gets a freshly baked pork belly pie. He knows Bernice is the finest cook in the valley, and he means to enjoy the bargain.

The Maclures and Stonefields have traded insults, brawls, and accusations across their pumpkin patches for generations. Bernice is furious at the thought of feeding the boy she believes stole her family's jewelry, yet she agrees to bake. You gather tender meat from the wild boars roaming the nearby pastures, and she sets aside her pride to get her prized necklace back.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Maybe if I got a pie, I could tell you who has that necklace. And you know, I think that old Bernice lady at that other farm makes great Pork Belly Pies...
Maybe if you gave her some chunks of boar meat from the boars that hang around our farms, and told her what it was for, she'd bake up a pie for you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I don't think it's right feeding the boy who stole my necklace in the first place, but if that's what it takes to get back what's mine, then so be it!
Do you have that boar meat?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Though this wild boar meat is tough, simmer it enough and it sure does make for some tasty pie!
